coordinates.position_routed: QB uses A2+C+D; RB/WR/TE use A2+D

interpretation.plain_english: The current-player board supports the fixed position-routed Forecast contender. A2 corrects the frozen baseline's implausible extreme-age QB persistence for Aaron Rodgers; C adds a small further QB adjustment; and D supplies economically sensible conditional-production redistribution. Young elite RB/WR/TE players retain strong multi-year value, while Christian McCaffrey receives appropriate aging attenuation. Sam Darnold remains below Bijan Robinson, Jahmyr Gibbs, and Puka Nacua on final routed Intrinsic. The remaining cross-position ordering is explained by governed Year 1 production and frozen lineup-scarcity Shapley mechanics, not a newly exposed downstream defect. Universal and routed challenger conclusions are materially consistent on this sentinel board.
interpretation.forecast_issue_assessment: The primary sentinel defect was Forecast-side extreme-age persistence in the frozen I1 baseline. The challenger resolves it without named-player tuning and without reopening Year 1.
interpretation.intrinsic_issue_assessment: No sentinel evidence warrants an immediate separate Intrinsic/Shapley defect audit. The routed board is economically coherent under the frozen lineup, seeds, permutation count, and discount.
interpretation.next_unexecuted_step: Management Forecast-selection and implementation-authorization decision for the fixed position route; no promotion or production implementation has occurred.
